title: LinkedIn Tools
description: Puts LinkedIn job capture, research, and outreach behind review queues, send receipts, and handoff packets, so risky browser actions stay controlled.
seoTitle: LinkedIn Tools Project | Guarded LinkedIn Automation Toolkit
seoDescription: How a guarded Bun and TypeScript toolkit runs LinkedIn analytics, job capture, Sales Navigator research, and reviewed outreach with send receipts and handoff packets.
constraints: The system had to separate read-only research from browser actions that can send messages, and make every send traceable to a reviewed draft.
The public portfolio example could not expose local LinkedIn state, private browser evidence, credentials, or live account data.
problem: LinkedIn job capture, hiring-team research, outreach, and follow-up work were too risky to run as scattered browser scripts.
The hard part was ownership: which workflow could send, which could only recommend, what evidence was captured, and what needed checking after uncertain browser behavior.
solution: Built one Bun and TypeScript command-line tool on SQLite for analytics export, job capture and enrichment, evidence-backed triage, read-only Sales Navigator research, and reviewed outreach drafts.
Put sends behind approved drafts and receipts that reserve one attempt per draft, block retries while a send may have gone out, and release only on confirmation that nothing was sent.
Added a SvelteKit review queue that groups hiring-team leads by person and records approval before the send path can run, and deterministic handoff packets for HubSpot, Instantly, and follow-up work.
result: Moved LinkedIn automation behind defined workflows with phased job intake, evidence-backed triage, review queues, send receipts, and scheduled follow-up packets.
Carried a multi-workflow Python suite into one tool through 30 schema migrations and a report that lists each proposed carry-over.
Created a public example of browser automation where state, evidence, and approval gates are part of the product from the start.
deliveryHighlights: One command-line tool exposes analytics, job capture, triage, Sales Navigator research, and outreach review.
Sends are tied to approved drafts and receipts, and retries stay blocked while an outcome is uncertain.
Handoff packets carry stored evidence and stop conditions, and receipt commands store external IDs without the tool calling those services.
